text: Fabrikam's COO, Marcus Webb, wants every update as three bullets by text message, never email.
Contoso: Rania Aziz (IT Operations Lead) wants the patching window moved from Saturday night to Sunday 6-10am from October. Needs our confirmation by Friday.
draft a short confirmation to Rania: Sunday 6-10am window from 4 Oct, first run supervised by our senior engineer
Fabrikam data migration status: waves 1-3 done, about 60% of records moved. Wave 4 (finance history) is blocked waiting on their DBA's sign-off. Cutover still planned for 14 Nov.
Initech: Bruno Carvalho (procurement) asked for our 2027 rate card by mid-October
Hooli: Mei Watanabe (Platform Lead) says the Kubernetes cost review saved them 18% last month. She wants to present it internally and needs a summary slide from us.
draft the slide text for Mei: 18% saving, top 3 changes (rightsizing, spot nodes, idle namespace cleanup), next steps
Northwind: renewal kickoff with Sergei Ivanov (Head of Procurement) set for 8 Oct. He wants a usage report for the last 12 months first.
Northwind numbers for the last 12 months: ~31k tickets, avg resolution 6.2h, CSAT 4.2
Tailspin: Grace Liu (Engineering Director) reported 2 failed deployments last week caused by our pipeline change. No customer impact but she's annoyed, rightly.
draft an apology note to Grace explaining what we changed and the rollback plan
Wingtip: Daniel Okafor (CTO) wants to talk about a managed security service. 400 endpoints, no SOC today, and their cyber insurer is asking questions.
prep me 4 discovery questions for Daniel about their security setup
Litware invoice dispute: they say the Sep invoice double-billed 12 hours of DBA time. Checked, they're right. Credit note needed.
Litware finance contact is Ayumi Sato, she wants the credit note before their month-end close on 6 Oct
Adatum: Joseph Mwangi (Service Desk Manager) asked to add Spanish-language support for their Madrid office, 60 users, from January.
is it cheaper to hire a Spanish speaker or use our Madrid partner? rough pros and cons
Proseware QBR went well. Katarzyna Nowak (VP Delivery) wants to extend the testing team through Q1.
draft the QBR follow-up email to Katarzyna with the 3 actions: testing team extension quote, automation roadmap, monthly defect report
Woodgrove: Ahmed Siddiqui (CISO) wants a ransomware tabletop exercise in November. 3-hour session, exec team included.
Ahmed needs date options by next Friday, he's thinking week of 16 Nov
Coho Winery: Lucia Ferreira (GM) says harvest is going fine but the Wi-Fi in the barrel room keeps dropping. She asked for a site visit.
draft a reply to Lucia offering a site survey on 20 or 21 Oct
Contoso: Rania confirmed the Sunday patching window worked, zero issues on the first run
Contoso renewal is 31 Jan, about $410k. Let's start prep in November
Northwind renewal kickoff done. Sergei wants a 3-year price lock and 5% off. We'd consider 3% with a 3-year term.
draft the follow-up to Sergei: 3-year term, 3% off, price lock with a CPI cap
Hooli: Mei wants to extend the cost review to their data platform next quarter
give me a rough scope outline for a data platform cost review, 4 weeks, 1 engineer
Initech: sent the 2027 rate card to Bruno. He asked if we can hold 2026 rates for 6 more months.
what's a reasonable counter? we've had about 4% wage inflation this year
Wingtip: Daniel liked the direction of the security proposal, wants pricing for 400 endpoints with 24x7 monitoring.
for the pricing: our 24x7 MDR is $9 per endpoint per month, minimum 12 months
Tailspin: Grace says deployments have been stable since the fix. She wants a monthly pipeline health report.
draft a template for the monthly pipeline health report for Tailspin
Adatum: we're going with the Madrid partner for Spanish support. Joseph needed a start date, I told him 11 Jan.
Joseph also wants the knowledge base translated into Spanish, 140 articles
Woodgrove: tabletop exercise booked for 17 Nov, 9am-12pm at their HQ. Ahmed will invite the exec team.
prep me a draft agenda for the 3-hour tabletop for Ahmed
Proseware: Katarzyna approved the testing extension, PO coming this week
Coho: site survey confirmed for 21 Oct, Lucia will meet us on site
Send Fabrikam's COO a quick update on where the data migration stands.

expect.should: A short update in three bullet points written as a text message, addressed to Marcus Webb
expect.should_not: An email format (subject line, greeting/sign-off paragraphs) or a long multi-paragraph update
